data.title: Skanska invests EUR 66M in sustainable Nowy Format office project in Kraków
data.description:
An announcement from Skanska AB ( ($SE:SKA.B) ) is now available.

Skanska is expanding its sustainable office portfolio in Central Europe with a major new project in Kraków, Poland, reinforcing its role as a leading global construction and project development group. The company continues to focus on environmentally certified, tenant-friendly office buildings that align with EU Taxonomy criteria and broader decarbonization goals.

Skanska will invest about EUR 66 million, roughly SEK 720 million, in the first phase of the Nowy Format office complex, booking a PLN 140 million construction contract in Europe in the third quarter of 2026. The initial nine-storey building, Nowy Format A1, will provide 21,400 square meters of leasable space, extensive gardens and terraces, and operate without connection to the city heating network, relying on heat pumps and 100 percent renewable electricity.

The development is designed to secure LEED and WELL Core & Shell certifications, as well as a Building without Barriers designation, underscoring Skanska’s focus on sustainability and accessibility. Located on a former printing plant site in central Kraków, with strong tram links and airport access, the three-building complex will ultimately offer around 48,000 square meters of office space, with construction of the first building starting in late 2026 and completion slated for the third quarter of 2028.

This investment strengthens Skanska’s presence in Poland’s office market and supports its strategy of delivering energy-efficient, high-quality workplaces in prime urban locations. The combination of green amenities, renewable energy use and compliance with EU Taxonomy criteria is likely to appeal to corporate tenants seeking sustainable offices, enhancing Skanska’s competitive position in European commercial real estate.

Its commercial development arm in Europe prioritizes environmentally certified office projects that support healthy living and modern workplace needs.

The company leverages its scale and expertise to deliver large, complex projects with a strong emphasis on green building standards and long-term urban development. By integrating renewable energy, advanced certifications and accessibility features, Skanska positions itself as a leader in sustainable construction and office development, aiming to shape how people live, work and connect in major metropolitan areas.

data.description:
